component.name: elder-terms
component.summary: GTK terminal for serial, TELNET, local shell, SSH, SFTP, and FTP connections

description.p: A terminal emulator inspired by personal computing in the 1990s. It supports local shells as well as serial, TELNET, FTP, FTPS, SSH, SFTP, and WebDAV connections from a single GTK3 application.

ul.li: Multiple saved connections launched from a tray-capable launcher
INI-based connection settings you can edit with any text editor
Character encoding, BS/DEL, cursor keys, and Enter/Return conversion
X/Y/ZMODEM transfers for TELNET, serial, and SSH sessions
File transfer windows for SFTP, FTP, FTPS, and WebDAV
Custom exterior colors, BEL sounds, fonts, and per-connection layout
